text:
Maya P: Heads-up — we need a lightweight war-room flow for HW + SI SEVs tied to the marketplace launch next month. Goal: clear handoffs, shared channels, and an on-call routing pattern so partners can escalate without delays. Any quick wins?
Ryan K: +1. Can we reuse the existing `#partnerships-sev` pattern or do we need a separate shared channel per partner?
Maya P: I'd prefer per-partner shared channels when possible (to keep alerts scoped). For large HW partners maybe a federated pattern: partner-specific channel + a global bridge.
Liz T: Per-partner channels make sense. We should standardize channel naming like `#partner-<org>-sev` and a README pinned with: escalation tree, contact list, oncall rota, and runbook link.
Anil S: For SRE/infra clarity we also need an automated banner when a channel is created with: severity definition, expected ack times, and escalation pager. Could be a bot message.
deploy-bot: Created channel template `#partner-<org>-sev` with pinned-template. Use `/partner-template create <org>` to instantiate.
Emma R: Need to add partner success + AE contacts to the channel before handing it off. Also legal asked that some HW partners require an invite-only shared channel (no public archives).
Joseph M: Agree on pinned runbook. Quick runbook snippet suggestion:```1) Triage in shared channel (5m ack)
2) If infra, tag @oncall-sre and escalate after 15m
3) If partner bug, @partner-engage then open bridge
4) If P1, open war-room and call list```
Liz T: Also include fallback routing: if our hosted infra is impacted, automatically route partner traffic to the Dedicated fallback model and notify partner ops. Small automation script can post to channel when fallback toggles.
Anil S: Example webhook payload to post to partner channel on escalation:
```
POST /api/notify
{ "partner": "ACME-HW", "sev": "P1", "incident_id": "#INC-1234", "route": "dedicated-fallback" }
```
Maya P: Good. What about shared oncall? Do we want partners to have direct paging to our SRE rotation or go through partner success first?
Ryan K: Prefer partner success first for non-blocker ops, but allow direct paging for verified P1s. We need an MSA-approved list of who can page.
Emma R: I'll coordinate with AE/legal to get the approved pager list and NDA status for invite-only channels. ETA EOD Tue.
Joseph M: I'll draft the escalation matrix and SLOs (ack/resolve targets) and drop it in the runbook.
Maya P: Action items: 1) Emma — partner approved pager list + NDA check (due Tue EOD) 2) Joseph — escalation matrix + SLOs (due Fri) 3) Anil — webhook + channel template work (PR by Thu) 4) Liz/Ryan — naming conventions + runbook template (sync Wed). I'll book a 30m sync Wednesday 9am PT.
Ryan K: :thumbsup:
Emma R: Thanks — I'll ping partners and start NDA checks.
Anil S: Starting PR draft now.
Joseph M: Will upload matrix to the runbook doc and tag this thread.
Maya P: Perfect. If anyone finds a competing existing flow, shout out here — otherwise we'll template this and roll it to the first three partners for the marketplace beta. :rocket:
